scope: All unique core spell IDs; one row per ID, with actual core-12 casting-class membership. Rules completeness is deliberately uncertified.
verification_boundary: Recorded slices refer to historical passing checks. Parsing is restored. The source-owned batch has dedicated effect and live encounter checks; see their evidence paths. Historical slices retain their older evidence and limitations. Availability is exported from the production gate, independently of delivery status. This is not a fresh audit of every SRD clause.

status_definitions.recorded_slice: Reviewed dated evidence for a working gameplay slice; remaining limitations and full rules audit stay open.
status_definitions.existing_checks_need_audit: Existing resolver/class-flow checks, but no reconciled complete spell audit.
status_definitions.implemented_unverified: New implementation awaiting a valid Godot gameplay run.
status_definitions.blocked: Known incomplete or unsupported behavior; production availability gate refuses before costs.
status_definitions.unimplemented_exposed: Known absent core effect still exposed to casting (should remain zero).
status_definitions.needs_audit: Loaded/listed; production behavior and rules completeness not yet established.

timed_effects.name: Timed effects, repeat saves and source tracking
timed_effects.next_shared_work: The seven-spell source-owned batch, including the rays and Hold spells, is delivered as bounded slices. Reuse SpellEffects and SpellEncounterLifecycle for remaining spells; audit individual expiry, repeat-save and campaign-persistence gaps.

control.name: Conditions, control and forced movement
control.next_shared_work: Share eligible-target saves, condition consequences on both sides, repeat saves, damage breaks and constrained movement. Keep exceptional orders narrow.

persistent_areas.name: Persistent areas, walls and triggered damage
persistent_areas.next_shared_work: The encounter-local zone lifetime, movement/turn triggers, trigger caps, terrain costs and concentration cleanup are delivered. Reuse CombatSpellZones, SpellZoneTerrain and SpellZoneConjurations; audit each remaining spell's geometry, triggers and lifetime before enabling it.

summons.name: Summons, companions and created combat entities
summons.next_shared_work: Find Familiar and Animate Dead have verified bounded Crown room/encounter slices. Created Undead retain existence after control expiry. Find Steed retains existing checks awaiting full audit. Animated objects and other created creatures remain open. Modern Conjure records remain in the area family.

visibility.name: Light, visibility and detection
visibility.next_shared_work: Obscuration, Invisibility, sense and detection slices now affect gameplay. Reuse their source-owned effects and SpellEncounterPerception; audit terrain line of sight, object visibility, missing sense outcomes and individual spell gaps. Light markers alone remain partial.

objects.name: Objects, inventory and environmental changes
objects.next_shared_work: Wave 1 ordinary rooms/objects/copies are the first implementation card. Finish their acceptance and campaign-time/exploration-casting foundations before separate Arcane Lock, Knock, Mage Hand and Mending integrations. Identify and Goodberry retain their recorded limits.

social_illusions.name: Dialogue, illusions and belief
social_illusions.next_shared_work: Reuse recipient/creature interaction, language, perception and explicit illusion outcomes. Store markers separately from actual belief or interaction effects.

campaign_information.name: Campaign information and communication
campaign_information.next_shared_work: Reuse the campaign clock and delivery ledger where suitable; add explicit information/recipient outcomes rather than success-only casts.

movement_travel.name: Movement, terrain, travel and other spaces
movement_travel.next_shared_work: Share movement modes and restrictions locally; keep campaign destinations, route validation and inter-plane travel separate from a combat teleport.

body_death.name: Death, bodies and transformations
body_death.next_shared_work: Party corpse identity/time, willingness, preservation and bounded Revivify/Gentle Repose now have production paths. Other bodies, created-undeath integration and reversible forms remain open; retain original character identity.

wards_removal.name: Wards, dispelling and restoring state
wards_removal.next_shared_work: Share effect identity/source, eligible removal, immunity, spell-level checks and item attunement where modeled; distinguish condition removal from full curse resolution.

weapon_riders.name: Weapon-triggered and repeated attacks
weapon_riders.next_shared_work: Reuse confirmed-hit riders, action/reaction timing, slot scaling and condition cleanup; avoid casting a weapon buff as an immediate ordinary damage spell.

exceptional.name: Exceptional world or action rules
exceptional.next_shared_work: Keep explicit supported modes for these unusual spells. Do not build a universal rule engine as a prerequisite for ordinary combat spells.

direct_resolution.name: Immediate attacks, saves, healing and area selection
direct_resolution.next_shared_work: Audit complete target sets, shapes, split damage, extra effects, thresholds and upcasting using existing resolution blocks. A positive damage roll alone is insufficient.

spells.name: Wall of Fire
spells.known_limit: Bounded gameplay slice verified 2026-10-08: the production record selects two in-range endpoints up to 60 feet apart and resolves initial Dexterity-save damage. Its slot-scaled zone and saved Concentration owner survive combat-to-room transfer and character/room reload. First entry into the wall and ending a turn in its danger footprint deal full Fire damage with separate trigger ledgers and no further save. The danger side is one adjacent five-foot caster-facing strip. Choosing either side, the full ten-foot strip, ring form, opaque wall, exact 20-foot height, 1-foot thickness, vertical targeting and non-hex geometry remain open.
